ios_ipados_unmanaged.status: CONDITIONAL — APP-STORE-VIABLE TECHNIQUE REQUIRES DEVICE PROOF
ios_ipados_unmanaged.candidate_minimum: exact physical iOS/iPadOS boundary not established
mechanisms: AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer.preventsCapture for one opaque protected image plane
AVPlayer.allowsCaptureOfClearKeyVideo for current supported ClearKey-encrypted video only
FairPlay Streaming for supported protected video
ios_ipados_unmanaged.execution_proof: BLOCKED — SOURCE TYPE-CHECKED; NO LINKED BUILD OR RUN
ios_ipados_unmanaged.reason: Apple exposes no general arbitrary UIKit/SwiftUI veto. SEC-03A confirms a supported capture-protected sample-buffer image plane and defines a whole-surface rasterized proof hypothesis. Every sensitive pixel must remain inside that plane; overlays, accessibility, first-frame, output, extraction, and failure behavior require physical proof.

ios_ipados_managed.candidate_minimum: exact supported enrolled-device profile and OS not yet tested
ios_ipados_managed.reason: The device-management restriction is an enterprise device boundary, not unmanaged application authority.

android.candidate_minimum: Android 14 / API 34 on an exact currently serviced, patched, Google Play-certified OEM device/build
mechanisms: SurfaceView.setSecure(true) for separately composed secure media surfaces
Play Integrity and hardware-backed key attestation as separate admission signals
android.reason: Public controls support a serious proof candidate, but no physical OEM/device capture, extraction, integrity, accessibility, or bypass matrix was executed. Android 12 and 13 are not retained as a blanket current admission floor.

windows.candidate_minimum: fully patched Windows 11 24H2 at minimum; Windows 11 25H2 or later preferred for a new consumer proof
mechanisms: WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE on every app-owned top-level HWND
ApplicationView.IsScreenCaptureEnabled=false in a separate UWP corroboration proof
AppCapture.SetAllowedAsync(false) for system app capture in a separate UWP proof
signed MSIX/package integrity and TPM-backed endpoint keys as separate trust layers
windows.reason: The public affinity API is not DRM and does not document every capture, remote-session, display, video, or framework path. No Windows execution environment was available.

mechanisms: FairPlay Streaming for supported protected video
